questions.q: 'One who knows many languages' — one word for this is—
questions.e: One who knows many languages = polyglot (বহুভাষাবিদ)।

questions.q: Choose the one-word substitute: 'One who cannot be corrected'
questions.e: One who cannot be corrected = incorrigible (সংশোধনের অযোগ্য)।

questions.q: Which single word means 'fear of heights'?

questions.q: 'Fear of water' — one word for this is—
